allHoliday.title: All Holidays
allHoliday.description: User created temporary and permanent holidays and birthdays with 1Y and ∞ badges

title.description: Title of the holiday, festival, or birthday

date.description: Date of the holiday in YYYY-MM-DD format

type.description: Type of holiday: temp (1 year) or perm (every year)

userEmail.description: Email of the user who purchased and added this holiday

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator

expiryDate.description: Expiry date string for temporary holidays (YYYY-MM-DD) or 'forever'

holidayReport.title: Holiday Report
holidayReport.description: User report for inappropriate or incorrect holiday entries

customHoliday.title: Custom Holiday
customHoliday.description: Custom festival or holiday added by the calendar administrator

name.description: Name of the holiday or festival

khasiName.description: Khasi or Pnar name of the holiday

month.description: Month of the year (0-11, where 0 is January)

year.description: Specific Gregorian year (2025-2100), or 0 for every year

description.description: Brief description of the festival or historical context

createdBy.description: UID of the admin who created the record

creatorEmail.description: Email of the admin who created the record

deletedHoliday.title: Deleted Holiday
deletedHoliday.description: Records of deleted or hidden holidays by calendar administrators

/all_holidays/{holidayId}.description: Publicly readable collection of all paid user-added holidays; writable by registered users; deletable by creator or admins.

/deleted_holidays/{holidayId}.description: Publicly readable list of deleted/hidden holiday IDs; writable by admins to remove unwanted built-in or public holidays.

/reports/{reportId}.description: User submitted complaint and report submissions.

/custom_holidays/{holidayId}.description: Publicly readable collection of custom holidays and festivals; writable only by verified administrators.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Restricted administrative records for managing authorization.
